aic_unavailable: The Art Institute is not responding. Retrying shortly.
image_unavailable: That image could not be loaded. Trying another.
no_matching_artwork: Nothing in the index matches those filters.
too_many_requests: Taking a short break. The next artwork follows shortly.
attribution: Digital image courtesy of the Art Institute of Chicago.
attribution_with_description: Digital image courtesy of the Art Institute of Chicago. Description: Art Institute of Chicago, CC BY 4.0.
ai_disclaimer: AI-generated from the museum's metadata. Not a curatorial text.
ai_budget_exhausted: The interpretation budget for today is spent.
ai_key_none: No key saved. Interpretation is off.
ai_key_environment: Using the {provider} key from .env. Remove it there to change it.
ai_key_saved: Key saved. Press I on an artwork to read an interpretation.
ai_key_invalid: That cannot be an API key — check for spaces or a partial paste.
ai_key_failed: The key could not be saved.
ai_storage_keyring: Keys are kept in your system keyring.
ai_storage_database: Keys are kept unencrypted in vitrine's own database file. Anyone who can read data/vitrine.db can read the key. Install the keyring extra to use your system keyring instead.
key_store_unavailable: Your system keyring refused to store the key.
panel_hint: Esc to close. Rotation is paused while this is open.
filters_no_index: No local index yet — run scripts/build_index.py to enable filters.
filters_too_thin: No type has {minimum} or more artworks behind it yet. Index more to enable filters.
